dimensions.mission_reliability: perceived ability to complete assigned work without avoidable failure
dimensions.team_safety: perceived ability/willingness to protect teammates while completing missions
dimensions.discretion: perceived secrecy, operational restraint, and information discipline
dimensions.intel_security: perceived ability to protect sensitive information/evidence
dimensions.capture_skill: perceived ability to take targets alive/controlled
dimensions.tracking_recon: perceived tracking, sensing, scouting, or reconnaissance competence
dimensions.lethality: perceived willingness/ability to kill when committed
dimensions.institutional_loyalty: perceived reliability toward the relevant village/house/institution

rule: Dimensions are audience beliefs, not objective stats. Omit unsupported dimensions instead of filling neutral values.
